IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Haigh, Tom, Hunt, Santos, Quall, Curtis, Wallace, Priest and Green

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that at least one school administrator in each school district have a state superintendent certificate.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school administrators with superintendentcertification; and amending RCW 28A.410.120.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.410.120 and 2005 c 497 s 208 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any other provision of this title, the Washingtonprofessional educator standards board or superintendent of publicinstruction shall not require any professional certification or otherqualifications of any person elected superintendent of a local schooldistrict by that district's board of directors, or any person hired inany manner to fill a position designated as, or which is, in fact,deputy superintendent, or assistant superintendent. However, eachschool district board of directors shall hire at least one schooladministrator with a state superintendent certificate who fills aseniorlevel administrative position within the district.
